en.description:
Tappy is a sensory fidget and self-care app where every tap, click, and swipe comes alive with satisfying sounds, haptics, and animations. Meet your new self-care pet, who levels up as you relax, breathe, journal, and build healthy habits. Join over a million people who fidget, stim, check in, and unwind with Tappy.

Tappy grows with you as you destress, stay focused, and build a routine that's all yours. Complete a Daily Adventure of quests and collect Sparks to unlock outfits, scenes, and surprises.

And it's all in one app: 25+ sensory fidgets, 9 breathing exercises, 40+ calming soundscapes, a mood journal, daily gratitude, a habit tracker, goal tracking, and 15 arcade games.

SENSORY FIDGETS YOU CAN FEEL
Stimming at your desk, waiting in line, or riding out a stressful moment? Tappy gives your hands something to do and your mind a place to settle. Every fidget uses haptic vibrations to mimic the real thing.
• Pop & click: pop Bubble Wrap, flip a light switch, and tap a grid of clicky buttons
• Clack & customize: build a mechanical keypad with real switch sounds, then swap switches, keycaps, and RGB lighting
• Zip & rip: drag a zipper open and shut, and tear Velcro apart
• Spin & stretch: flick a Fidget Spinner, stretch a slinky, and spin a crackling vinyl record
• Swirl & glow: smear colorful fluid, pluck neon strings, and pull a galaxy into orbit in the Cosmic Vortex
• Haptic Calming Strip: pin a strip that floats over the app, always within reach
• Sound on for satisfying audio, or off for a silent, discreet stim anywhere

DESTRESS & UNWIND
• 9 breathing exercises to calm down, refocus, or fall asleep, guided by vibrations you can follow with eyes closed
• Guided meditations and a 5 senses exercise to ground you in the present
• 40+ Feelscapes: soothing vibration patterns paired with a soundscape, like rain, white noise, and ocean waves, with a sleep timer

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURE, YOUR WAY
• Choose from 25+ quests: breathe, fidget, journal, drink water, step outside, move your body, practice gratitude, reach out to a friend, brush your teeth, wind down, or write your own
• Arrange them in any order and set a daily reminder to build a routine that sticks
• Finish your adventure to open a treasure chest of Sparks. The bigger the adventure, the bigger the reward

TAKE CARE OF TAPPY
• Give Tappy a name, then pet, feed, hug, play, and tuck Tappy in
• Do all five plus a quest to fill the Care Bar for a daily surprise gift
• Earn badges as you hit new milestones together
• Set a bedtime and get Tappy ready for bed in a cozy bedtime outfit
• Spend Sparks on dozens of hats, glasses, outfits, and props, with new items added regularly
• Unlock scenes like the beach, a farm, a castle, and outer space, where visitors like a crab or a dragon wander by. Tap one for bonus Sparks

STAY FOCUSED & ON TRACK
• Mood Journal: reflect on how you feel, tag your feelings and what's behind them, and spot trends in Insights
• Planner & To-Dos: a timeline of timed and anytime tasks, priorities, and reminders
• Habit Tracker: build healthy routines with custom icons, colors, schedules, reminders, streaks, and stats, then create your own challenges
• Goals: set short and long-term goals, break them into steps, and celebrate your progress
• Focus Timer: beat procrastination and collect Sparks as you focus

QUICK GAMES
• 15 arcade games, including Mini Golf, Tappy Stack, Snake, Zen Pond, Color Swipe, Runner, and Pop It!
• Challenge a friend on one phone in Fastest Tapper, Four In A Row, and Tappy Battle
• Climb Game Center leaderboards

BUILT FOR IPHONE AND APPLE WATCH
• Apple Health: save mindful minutes, and sync your mood as State of Mind with Tappy Plus
• Widgets: check off habits and see your Daily Adventure from your Home Screen
• Live Activities: follow timed quests from your Lock Screen
• Apple Watch: a quick, discreet fidget on your wrist

Rated 4.8 stars from 20,000+ ratings.

Terms: https://tappy.net/terms
Privacy: https://tappy.net/privacy
